Introduce Provenance domain concepts and actions.

Usage: provenance prime [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --quiet            Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --repo <REPO>      Deprecated: accepted for compatibility; guidance does not use a repository [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>    Deprecated: accepted for compatibility; guidance does not use a scope [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>  [default: markdown] [possible values: json, markdown]
      --include-threads  Deprecated: accepted for compatibility; guidance does not include project threads
  -h, --help             Print help
